prompt:
The section sections/promo-strip-2.liquid already renders a promo strip with a message and an optional discount code. Add a savings line computed with integer arithmetic. Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte. Keep the existing whitespace-control style so the output has no whitespace or newlines between tags. Inputs. All are under section.settings; nothing is top-level: - section.settings.message: string or null. - section.settings.code: string or null. - section.settings.compare_cents: non-negative integer or null. This is the original price in cents. - section.settings.price_cents: non-negative integer or null. This is the sale price in cents. Existing behaviour (keep it): - Strip message and code. A null value counts as an empty string. - If the stripped message is empty, output nothing at all. - Otherwise output
. - Inside it comes

MESSAGE

, where MESSAGE is the stripped message, HTML-escaped. - If the stripped code is non-empty, CODE follows (stripped, escaped). Then
. New behaviour. A deal line is inserted between the message paragraph and the code span. It appears only when all of these hold: 1. Both compare_cents and price_cents are non-null. 2. compare_cents > price_cents. 3. The rounded percentage P (below) is at least 1. Computing P: - P = (compare_cents - price_cents) * 100 / compare_cents, rounded to the nearest integer with exact halves rounding up. For example, 0.5 becomes 1, 12.5 becomes 13 and 66.67 becomes 67. - If price_cents > 0 and P would be greater than 99, use 99. - When price_cents is 0, P is 100. The deal line is exactly:

Save P%: COMPARE PRICE

COMPARE and PRICE are formatted as $D.CC: - D is cents divided by 100, with no thousands separators. - CC is cents modulo 100, zero-padded to two digits. - Examples: 4000 is $40.00, 1 is $0.01, 1505 is $15.05 and 0 is $0.00. If the message is empty, nothing is output even when the prices qualify. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/promo-strip-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
